Requirement Description: Personal data processed lawfully fairly and in a transparent manner.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Explicit consent collected at registration. Clear privacy notice informing users of trade usage.
Technical & Organizational Control: Terms and Privacy checkbox on signup; public privacy guidelines.

Requirement Description: Data collected for specified explicit and legitimate purposes only.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Data collected strictly for agricultural marketplace operations and verified blockchain tracking.
Technical & Organizational Control: Strict schema definition; no secondary commercial data sale or profiling.

Requirement Description: Personal data collected must be adequate relevant and limited to necessity.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Only essential trade fields requested (Name Email Location Phone). No sensitive biometric or financial KYC required.
Technical & Organizational Control: Registration form requests only 4 fields. Optional profile data can be omitted.

Requirement Description: Personal data must be accurate and kept up to date.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Users can view and update their profile details location and listings at any time.
Technical & Organizational Control: Profile update and listing edit controllers provide immediate state synchronization.

Requirement Description: Kept in identifying form no longer than necessary for specified purposes.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Soft-anonymization and auto-archival for inactive accounts. Trade logs anonymized upon request.
Technical & Organizational Control: Retention schedules mapped in Data Classification policy; deletion cron jobs.

Requirement Description: Data processed securely including protection against unauthorized access or loss.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Passwords hashed with bcrypt (cost 12). Sessions secured via JWT (24h). All traffic protected via TLS.
Technical & Organizational Control: Bcrypt hashing; Helmet security headers; rate limiting on auth endpoints (10 attempts/15m).

Requirement Description: Data controller responsible for and able to demonstrate compliance with principles.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Comprehensive data mapping spreadsheets and administrative security configuration audit logs.
Technical & Organizational Control: Internal security module; data classification catalog; cryptographic ledger proofs.

Requirement Description: Users have right to obtain confirmation and copy of personal data processed.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Users can view complete profile listings messages and blockchain transaction history.
Technical & Organizational Control: Dashboard provides full view of all personal records and active listings.

Requirement Description: Right to obtain rectification of inaccurate personal data without undue delay.
AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Interactive edit functions for listings profile location and contact details.
Technical & Organizational Control: Immediate database update with timestamp tracking (updated_at).

AgriConnect Implementation Mechanism: Account disablement functionality enables immediate suspension of trading activities.

Requirement Description: Right to receive personal data in structured commonly used machine-readable format.
